summary: Full backend + frontend testing of new in-app multi-seat 客服 (CS) system. 23/23 backend pytest cases passed covering public config, visitor /cs/start session + agent assignment, weighted round-robin (ratio ~1:3 verified), visitor<->agent message round trip with no duplicates, agent JWT auth (login/me, 401 for wrong pw and missing/invalid token), agent session isolation (404 when accessing another agent's session), per-agent quick replies, admin agent CRUD (duplicate username 400, empty password keeps existing, delete), admin CS config get/put roundtrip, admin stats, and fallback when CS disabled. Frontend visitor widget on /p/about works: floating/center/CTA buttons all open cs-widget, agent name '客服小海' shown, welcome message rendered, sent message appears EXACTLY once even after 2s polling (dedup OK, no regression on the previously-fixed dup bug). Agent workbench /cs login+sessions list (4 sessions)+messages+reply+quick replies add+click+logout all functional. Admin 在线客服 tab shows cs-admin with config toggle, welcome textarea, save, agents table (edit/delete buttons), and 新增坐席 opens cs-agent-form.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2812 lines — exceeds the 700 LOC guideline; recommend splitting the CS system (~340 lines) into backend/routers/cs.py and the chat/AI section similarly.
cs_start declares status_code=201 but returns {enabled:false} without creating a session; a 200 or an explicit response_model would be semantically cleaner.
assign_cs_agent reads ALL enabled agents from DB on every /cs/start call — fine at current scale but if agent count grows, consider indexing/limiting or caching.
No pagination on /cs/agent/sessions (hard limit 500). Acceptable for MVP; add pagination later.
Public endpoints /cs/start, /cs/{sid}/message, /cs/{sid}/messages have no rate limiting — a bot could spam sessions/messages. Consider per-IP rate limiting.
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_* agents during round-robin and CRUD scenarios and cleaned them up via module-scope fixture (created_agents) teardown. No leftover test data expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_cs_system.py; run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_cs_system.py -v -o addopts=''` (the project pytest.ini forces xdist loadscope which is fine too). The round-robin test temporarily disables ALL currently-enabled agents, creates 2 TEST agents with weights 1 and 3, drives 16 sessions, then re-enables originals in a finally block. If a prior test run was interrupted, some test agents may linger — run `curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin>' $URL/api/admin/cs/agents` and delete leftovers whose remark starts with 'TEST_'. Dedup logic in CSWidget.jsx was verified both via visitor side (1 occurrence after 5s) — do not touch sender|text matching logic.
